mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and nephrotoxicity, which may impair codeine metabolism and increase CNS depression risk; codeine may worsen foscarnet-induced nephrotoxicity through additive effects on renal function.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and signs of excessive CNS depression; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative analgesic if renal impairment develops.
